A rhetorical inner beat argues something that MOVES over time; it must be classified to a named shape, with on-screen data drawn ONLY from the beat's own narration + SOURCES.md (nothing invented), and the pattern table signed off before the component is built.
note: Among the body beats (B01-B06) only B02 is rhetorical. B01 fanout, B03 pipeline, B04 dependency graph, B05 weekly table, and B06 caution-chip checklist are STRUCTURAL (they enumerate parts of a system), so they need no anim.json entry.

B02.nearest_kin: BinaryBranch (runtime/remotion/src/deckPatterns.tsx) — a claim that resolves left/right, adapted to a list → path transformation
B02.claim_that_moves: A ranked-by-similarity list (retrieval) cannot express 'read A before B'. The same sections re-thread into a dependency-ordered path (reorder). One high-similarity section lifts out to a 'held back' tray (select, don't retrieve).

data_on_screen.left_marks: ranked bars, sorted by LENGTH only (relative similarity) — no percentages, no numbers
data_on_screen.unanswered_badge: read first? — the ranker can't say
data_on_screen.right_marks: A → B → C → D dependency path, drawn on
data_on_screen.held_back: high-similarity, not needed yet — held back

guardrails: No similarity percentages or any invented numbers on screen (bar length carries relative similarity).
